context_quotes: The ultralow thermal conductivity is linked to a disordered nature of silver in the structure, displaying extremely large silver atomic displacement parameters obtained from multitemperature synchrotron powder x-ray scattering measurements and silver ionic conductivity at elevated temperatures.

records.subject: Poly(ionic liquid)-mediated hybridization of graphene and CNT
records.quote: Integration of 1D and 2D carbon materials into hybrid carbon composites is achieved by coupling graphene and CNT through poly(ionic liquid) (PIL) mediated-hybridization.
context_quotes: The resulting CNT/PIL/graphene hybrid materials are explored as active materials in chemical and temperature sensors.
